---
description: world_status as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
arguments:
  world: "A world, by its id; left out, the world this chat plays."
---
Says where a world's draft stands: the revision it started from, the revision that is head now, whether the draft is behind it, whether a draft is kept apart from the head, its version, and the world's own checks of it (errors, warnings, and the first issues). Nothing is changed.
